ai_summary: AXISCADES is executing a major strategic pivot, divesting non-core businesses (Phase 1 complete) to focus on high-growth defense, aerospace, and deep-tech (XiDA) segments, which collectively achieved 30% YoY revenue growth in Q2 FY27. Despite strong core performance, continuing operations reported a Q2 loss due to one-time non-cash write-offs of legacy acquisitions and elevated ESOP/restructuring costs, rather than operational issues. Management projects a return to strong profitability and 15-20%+ EBITDA margins by Q3/Q4 as costs normalize and core businesses scale, though a delayed second divestment phase and supply chain issues are noted as potential headwinds.
